correctness.rationale: The explicit equivariant homeomorphism from the full deleted product to the standard permutation-representation sphere verifies the orientation twist; the codimension-two skeleton deletes exactly 2n top cells. Relative cellular chains form a single orientation-twisted permutation lattice; an oriented sphere fundamental class has coefficient +1 on each removed cell, giving a primitive diagonal injection. The long exact sequence gives the precise integral quotient lattice and vanishing in all other reduced degrees. The character and rational quotient formulas follow by fixed-point traces and rational transfer. Exact independent-of-proof cellular enumerations for n=4 through 7 confirm low-parameter boundaries, orientations, and character identities.

It identifies the correct non-split integral quotient presentation rather than merely the rational character, and the particle-exchange parity changes rational homology of the unordered quotient.
